questions.question: Which is the correct statement for a well-designed physical setting of the anganwadi?
options: [A] The physical setting must be safe, secure, hygienic, comfortable, attractive and well-designed to help the anganwadi children to get engaged in the table and chair activities and learn happily.
[B] The physical setting must be safe, secure, hygienic, comfortable, attractive and well-designed to help the anganwadi children to get engaged in the project based activities and learn happily.
[C] The physical setting must be safe, secure, hygienic, comfortable, attractive and well-designed to help the anganwadi children to get engaged in play based activities and learn happily.
[D] The physical setting must be safe, secure, hygienic, comfortable, attractive and well-designed to help the anganwadi children to get engaged in the teacher-guided activities and learn nicely.
questions.answer: [C] The physical setting must be safe, secure, hygienic, comfortable, attractive and well-designed to help the anganwadi children to get engaged in play based activities and learn happily.
